confidence_notes: Food anchors (beer, coffee, meals) are based on aggregated travel-site price ranges, some of them crowdsourced or dated, so they are approximate. Cocktail and wine_glass use the local beer relationship because no current Lijiang bar prices were found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings. FX 0.6955 is the RBA 4.00 pm observation for 2026-10-15 as shown in a search snippet of the RBA exchange rates page; I did not open that page directly. A third-party 2026-10-16 figure of 0.6947 was unconfirmed and not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a low-cost Yunnan highland tourist town, with Old Town tourist pricing assumed for July high season. Restaurant and drink anchors follow travel-site ranges for Lijiang. Accommodation is benchmarked to typical budget and mid-range guesthouse levels in similar Chinese heritage-tourism towns.
